title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. Activities and the objective include strengthen community-based water, rangeland and soil conservation management structures, Train and accompany CMDRR committees to do risk analysis and DRR plan preparation, Support community early warning systems including synergies between national / global systems, fund small anticipatory and response to test partner and community preparedness capacity, so communities adopt measures and approaches which strengthen their resilience to cope with crises and shocks. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat and Association of Pastoralist community for change. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Increase the resilience of poor and marginalised rural communities by mitigating and adapting to the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation.- Strengthen climate disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have - Disaster Risk Management reduces the vulnerability of households and communities to the impacts of climate change, supporting them to adapt to a changing climate and the associated hazards e.g. increased flooding, drought and cyclones etc. Preparedness involves measures to reduce the impacts of these hazards, further contributing to climate adaptation
